about.title: About
about.heading: Fifteen years of making finance clear
about.intro: Northline Advisory was founded in 2011 in Midtown Manhattan with a simple idea: growing companies deserve senior financial expertise without the cost of a full in-house team.
about.story1: Our founders met as managers at a Big Four firm, where they saw the same pattern again and again: talented founders making major decisions on numbers that were months out of date.
about.story2: They opened Northline on Lexington Avenue with three clients and a promise to close the books on time, every month. Today a team of 40+ CPAs, enrolled agents and finance analysts supports more than 600 companies across the United States.
about.story3: We are still independent, still senior-led and still obsessed with the same thing: giving our clients numbers they can act on.

clarity.text: We explain every number in plain language and tell you what it means for your next decision.
